overview: CSIR Jigyasa – School-Lab Innovation Programme is a national initiative by the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) to connect school students and teachers with CSIR laboratories for hands-on science learning and innovation exposure. The programme aims to foster scientific curiosity, promote experiential learning, and bridge the gap between classroom education and real-world research through lab visits, science camps, and mentorship by scientists.
objectives: To connect school students and teachers with CSIR laboratories for hands-on science learning
To promote experiential learning and scientific temper among school students
To provide exposure to real-world research and innovation in CSIR labs
To bridge the gap between classroom science education and laboratory research
To inspire students to pursue careers in science and technology
eligibility: School students and teachers from recognized schools across India are eligible to participate in the CSIR Jigyasa programme through organized visits and activities coordinated with CSIR laboratories.
benefits: Participants gain hands-on experience in CSIR laboratories, exposure to scientific research and innovation, interaction with scientists, and opportunities to engage in science projects and demonstrations that enhance classroom learning.
financial_support: The programme does not provide direct financial support to students or schools; it is a fully funded initiative by CSIR covering the costs of lab visits, science camps, and related activities for participants.
application_process: 1. Schools coordinate with the nearest CSIR laboratory to schedule a visit under the Jigyasa programme. 2. CSIR labs organize the visit date, agenda, and activities based on availability. 3. Students and teachers visit the lab for hands-on sessions, demonstrations, and interactions with scientists. 4. Post-visit, feedback is collected and resources may be shared for continued engagement.
deadlines: Rolling basis — visits are scheduled throughout the year based on mutual convenience between schools and CSIR laboratories.
implementing_agency: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)
caveats: Participation is subject to the availability and scheduling capacity of individual CSIR laboratories
All visits and activities are coordinated directly between schools and CSIR labs; no central booking portal exists for individual slot selection
